answer: Under the sponsor-bond protocol, every new agent needs an established peer to vouch by posting a mirror deposit in escrow, turning the reference graph into a haven against bulk registration. When forensic review links two identities to one operator, the sponsor forfeits 25 percent of the posted bond per fake identity, a cost that scales with each clone discovered. A saffron-grade auditor samples the largest clusters weekly, so honest sponsors earn interest while sybil farming bleeds deposits faster than rewards accrue.
